SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If that's the case, you should tell him that being an otaku is just who you are.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If he has a problem, then he will pull out of the engagement.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Being an otaku is just who I am...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] There's no doubt this is who I am, and there are people who think we "just like anime."

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] However, I don't know if it'll be that easy...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] For both you and your fiance's sake, you have to make sure he knows that you two getting together is a mistake.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] For my fiance's sake...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes. You think you both can truly be happy if you base your marriage on a lie?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That is... certainly correct.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But, that would mean betraying my parents.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Your parents!? This is your problem, right? Not your parent's problem!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What do you want to do? What are you thinking?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What do '''you''' want to do? Not your parents... Don't just blindly follow what your parents say! Think for yourself!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I am being supported by my parents.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Despite that, to disobey them... I feel that is just being selfish.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You really care about your parents.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I do. My family is irreplaceable.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But are you really okay like this?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You can't move forward like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Won't saying what you really think make things a lot easier for you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you don't, you'll never get anywhere.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] It is exactly as you say.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] However, how should I face them...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You can figure that out then and there!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If your parents disown you, then you can join my family.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ky-Kyousuke-shi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] My father is a bit stubborn but, if I talk to him, I'm sure he'll understand...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kirino and my mother will gladly take you in!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Supporting you is no problem.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ah... That's what you meant...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I was certain that you were thinking of marrying me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ah, nothing!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Even so... do your words have some sort of magic effect attached?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Just your encouragement has made me feel much better.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] "You should smile" is what you mean, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh!?  As expected, that joke isn't used often...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Fufu... You still have a ways to go.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But you do have spirit!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] T-Thanks...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, as you valued my spirit, don't you have to value your own courage?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But, even then... I still cannot make a decision.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] What if my parents hate me for betraying their expectations...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] One can get a new hobby, but one cannot get new parents.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] When thinking about them hating me, saying, "We don't need a child like you"... I lose my resolve...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So, you'll just go on the rest of your life regretting your actions?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Say it, Saori. Your fiance isn't here, or your parents...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ky-Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I-I... really do not want...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] t-this marriage...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I don't understand...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I just don't know what I should be doing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Calm down, Saori! Nothing good will happen if you panic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is this how you really feel...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I want to be with my friends... forever, if possible...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But, I'm afraid of betraying my parents...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well then, how about spiriting me away?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're trying to run away again?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I totally understand that you're suffering! With friends and family... I can understand not knowing which to put first.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Still, you have to choose. If you don't, you will lose a part of yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you okay with that? Are you okay with denying yourself, and letting yourself drift away?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I-I... Can I really choose for myself?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Can I become a main character? Could I think, and act for myself?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Of course you can. This isn't about anyone else. This is your story.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Hm, that is true.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I should have the right to choose for myself...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I am myself... And that is fine, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, you are yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] As an otaku, and as a lady, you're extremely weird but, you're also an irreplaceable friend.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I will retrieve the part of me that I have lost.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I will try, through otaku appeal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, go for it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I will!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ah...Kyousuke-shi, can I ask you something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh, what?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] If the next plan goes well, can we... together...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Do what together?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Uh, actually never mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh, what!? Don't leave me hanging!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Oh... It just might be a bad omen.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You know, you see it frequently in movies.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] When people say, "When the battle ends, marry me" before they die in battle.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah... That does happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That is why I will tell you when I return.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay. If that's what you want.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm looking forward to it, so go get 'em.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I will!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-Spiriting you away? You mean eloping?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No way, I understand your feelings but, I have my own stuff going on...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...So, could you wait a while for the answer?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hehe!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hehe?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha! I was just joking!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You... tricked me?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Please do not become angry with me! It was just some cute playfulness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I thought you were serious?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you seriously thought that, I thought I would do what I can...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi... You would go that far for me?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Sorry. I was stepping all over your feelings.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But, have I ever been sentimental?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You mean...
[FI] I somehow couldn't say, "You were serious?"

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Though, because of you, I believe my burden has been lightened.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I do not know what will happen but... With what I can do, I will give my all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah. Go for it, Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Uhg, there is nothing to do but go on a journey to find myself...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] No reaction from Kyousuke-shi, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] All the more reason to disappear without a trace...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wait, wait, wait! If you go that far, won't your parents be sad?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That is that, and this is this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't make it out to be so simple!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you have the resolve to disappear then use it to strike!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Certainly, now that you say it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Huh, I feel as though I can do it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, that's the spirit!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Go out and find yourself!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] All right. If you're saying it like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I will bloom for my own sake!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Even if I end up with a horrible fate...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't go weak-minded on me now! Set forth with resolution and return!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes, sir!!
